text: Which multiple-testing correction procedure controls the false discovery rate (FDR) and is described as standard practice in genomics, in contrast to a more conservative family-wise-error-rate method?
choices: Bayesian model comparison via Bayes factors
explanation: The Benjamini-Hochberg procedure controls the false discovery rate and is explicitly noted as standard practice in genomics, where thousands of hypotheses are often tested at once. Bonferroni instead controls the family-wise error rate and is the more conservative method being contrasted. Maximum likelihood estimation is a parameter-fitting technique, and Bayes factors are used for Bayesian model comparison -- neither is a multiple-testing correction procedure.
